supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s locate numbers on the number line when we are given the location of one fraction. Required Preparation CCSS Standards Addressing 3.NF.A.2 Lesson Timeline Warm-up 10 min Activity 1 20 min Activity 2 15 min Lesson Synthesis 10 min Cool-down 5 mi
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Locate 1 on the number line given the location of a non-unit fraction.
teachingSteps: Choose the whole interval from zero to one.
Partition it into equal intervals according to the denominator.
Count intervals from zero to locate and name the numerator position.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Intervals must be equal; tick count is not the same as interval count from zero.
